topic: The Discovery of the Cullinan Diamond
hook: The story of the Cullinan Diamond: the largest gem-quality rough diamond ever found, weighing a staggering 3,106 carats.

evidence.title: 1907: The Cullinan Diamond is presented to King Edward VII on his birthday.

angle: Focus on the brutal irony that the miners who unearthed the largest diamond in history received a meager bonus while the mine owner profited wildly and used the stone to buy favor with the British monarchy.
what_others_do: Existing videos typically focus solely on the dramatic discovery, the sheer physical size of the Cullinan, and its eventual integration into the British Crown Jewels.
